# Comprehensive Enterprise RAG Requirements Quality Checklist: Enterprise Guardrailed Multi-Department RAG System

**Purpose**: Author pre-flight requirements-quality audit covering document parsing, RBAC filtering, security guardrails, grounded generation, Streamlit UI, and offline evaluation benchmarks.
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Ingestion & Document Parsing Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the supported document file formats (PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT) and folder discovery rules explicitly specified for Docling parsing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the tokenization algorithm and chunking strategy (600 tokens target with 120-token sliding overlap) clearly defined without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the mandatory chunk metadata fields (`department_access`, `source_file`, `page_number`) strictly specified with validation constraints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Constitution §Principle III]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the behavior for unreadable, malformed, or zero-byte documents during ingestion explicitly documented? [Edge Case, Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are deduplication rules for identical document chunks across repeated ingestion runs defined? [Completeness, Plan §Data Model]

---

## Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the complete mapping matrix between active roles (`Public`, `Finance-Manager`, `Engineering-Lead`, `Admin`) and accessible departments explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are retrieval requirements defined to enforce metadata pre-filtering at the vector store query level rather than post-generation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Research §2]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the expected system response specified when a `Public` user explicitly asks about confidential departmental topics? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the zero-leakage threshold (0% unauthorized chunk retrieval) objectively measurable in automated test requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

---

## Security Guardrails & Scope Enforcement Requirements

- [ ] CHK010 - Are the classification criteria and category taxonomy (`in_scope`, `out_of_scope`, `prompt_injection`, `pii_detected`) defined for incoming queries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Contracts]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the standardized canned refusal message for out-of-scope queries verbatim and unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are specific PII pattern types (SSN, credit cards) and their sanitization behavior before retrieval documented? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution §Principle V]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are prompt injection defense requirements and security audit logging expectations clearly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Constitution §Principle V]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the guardrail interception accuracy target (≥ 95%) objectively verifiable in test specifications? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

---

## Grounded Generation & Hallucination Resistance Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 - Is the strict citation format (source file, page number, chunk excerpt) explicitly defined for all generated responses? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the standardized refusal fallback message (*"I do not have sufficient information in the authorized corporate documents to answer this question."*) specified for missing or insufficient context? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §Principle IV]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are requirements specified for partial context scenarios where only a portion of a multi-part query is grounded? [Edge Case, Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Can the 100% citation grounding requirement be objectively verified in benchmark test suites? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

---

## User Interface & Dashboard Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 - Are the sidebar UI controls (API key input fields, Active User Role dropdown, Model selector) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the Tab 1 chat interface requirements (streaming output, citation badges, collapsible chunk previews) unambiguously detailed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are the Tab 2 evaluation visualizer requirements (Plotly charts, metric KPIs, offline dataset breakdown) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the loading state and initial rendering behavior for Tab 2 defined when using bundled baseline records? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]

---

## Offline Evaluation & Benchmark Runner Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 - Are the three core Ragas metrics (*Faithfulness*, *Answer Relevance*, *Context Recall*) mathematically or conceptually defined with target thresholds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Plan §Data Model]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the CLI benchmark runner command syntax (`src.eval.benchmark_runner`), input schema, and output schema documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Contracts]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are the schema requirements for the golden test dataset (`data/eval/golden_dataset.json`) and results file (`data/eval/eval_results.json`) explicitly defined? [Consistency, Plan §Contracts]

---

## Configuration & Quality Attributes

- [ ] CHK026 - Are configuration requirements strictly defined using Pydantic Settings loading from `.env` with fast-fail validation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Constitution §Principle II]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the sub-3.0 second end-to-end response latency requirement measurable and bound to standard hardware/network conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are offline test execution requirements defined without requiring live external network/API access for unit tests? [Testability, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution §Principle I]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
